name: synthetic_press
register: third-person documentary narration, restrained and authoritative; people are seen, not heard
style_suffix: prestige documentary cinematography, contemporary and recent-historical settings (2010s-2020s), cool controlled colour grade — deep navy shadows, restrained amber practical light, bone-white highlights; naturalistic and precise rather than painterly, muted but clean, fine cinematic grain, shallow depth of field, deliberate composition, editorial restraint, the visual language of a high-end streaming documentary — never theatrical, never candlelit-historical, never melodramatic
default_music_prompt: Restrained, tense cinematic underscore for a prestige documentary about technology, ambition and power. A low sustained synth drone, sparse piano, faint pulse of unease. Modern and controlled — not orchestral-melodramatic. Builds quiet tension under a narrator without ever competing with the voice. Cool, intelligent, foreboding.
notes: Synthetic Press flagship. AI-documentary, 'AI-drama not AI-doom'. Palette: navy #0a1628, amber #d4a017, bone #f4f1ea, rust #8b3a1e. Two-mode visuals: Mode A cinematic recreation (this engine) + Mode B Remotion graphics. Voice Victor as placeholder; real human-voice swap via finish --assemble-only true-up. Renders 1920x1080 to match Mode B. Created June 2026, OpenAI series launch.
